title: RepoRise M8.7 Hidden Generalization & Human-Gold Evaluation

F01.name: Missing semantic signal
F01.description: Documentation communicates concept with non-standard terminology missed by regex patterns

F02.name: False-positive semantic signal
F02.description: Superficial keyword match triggered without conveying substantive technical content

F03.name: Structural mismatch
F03.description: Section content positioned under unconventional heading level, badge container, or tab interface

F04.name: Evidence-quality mismatch
F04.description: Basic evidence awarded high surface score where rater required formal diagrams/citations

F05.name: Granularity mismatch
F05.description: Score bucketing threshold too coarse or sensitive near bucket boundary (e.g. 69 vs 70)

F06.name: Context/window limitation
F06.description: Signal presence valid only when combined with prerequisite domain context

F07.name: Cross-section reasoning failure
F07.description: Information split across separate sections requiring synthesis

F08.name: Documentation-architecture failure
F08.description: Crucial discoverability assets housed in external /docs/ or monorepo subpackages

F09.name: Comparative/evaluative failure
F09.description: Subtle differentiator vs competitor present in prose but missed by strict heuristics

F10.name: Unknown / unclassified
F10.description: Residual variance not captured by existing heuristic structural abstractions
